scope: Supertonic 3 vocoder-first QNN/HTP feasibility; tiny physical HTP execution is proven, but no vocoder inference or speedup is claimed

android_runtime_files.distribution: local-only; all files and raw profiles remain ignored

libQnnHtpPrepare.so.note: QAIRT 2.49 loads this library dynamically; omitting it caused the first tiny session to fail closed before HTP execution.

first_attempt.detail: The initial stage omitted libQnnHtpPrepare.so. ORT refused the session because nodes remained on the default CPU EP while fallback was disabled. This is deployment evidence, not a model-support result.

accepted_attempt.conclusion: Actual SM8550 HTP execution is proven for the tiny control with CPU fallback disabled.

crash_root_cause.bug: ORT 1.27.1 allowed an empty dq_nodes vector and then unconditionally dereferenced dq_nodes[0].

upstream_fix.subject: [QNN EP] Fix segfault on PadNodeGroupSelector::Check when dq_nodes is empty

crash_root_cause.conclusion: The original status-139 failure is not emulator-only and occurs in ORT capability analysis before QNN graph composition or vocoder inference.

runtime.label: ONNX Runtime 1.27.1 plus upstream a08e17 minimal backport

fixed_released_derivative.note: The upstream patch removes the crash; ORT then fails closed because sixteen nodes remain outside QNN.

folded_weight_only_fixed_derivative.derivation: fold exactly eight weight-only per-channel DequantizeLinear constant tails, then concretize the recorded I/O shapes

same_runtime_cpu_equivalence.claim_limit: This proves only same-runtime derivative equivalence; it is not an HTP numerical pass.

optimization_level_sweep.result: No level creates a complete no-fallback QNN session. Levels 1, 2, and 99 retain the same eight unsupported Erf nodes; level 0 has substantially worse delegation.

interpretation.unpatched_ort_vocoder_path: blocked by a confirmed upstream ORT bug
interpretation.patched_exact_fixed_vocoder_path: blocked by eight Erf nodes plus eight weight-only DQ nodes
interpretation.patched_folded_fixed_vocoder_path: blocked only by eight Erf nodes in decomposed GELU patterns
interpretation.likely_next_technical_route: replace the eight standard decomposed GELU subgraphs with explicit com.microsoft.Gelu nodes as a separately labeled derivative, or construct an explicit CPU/HTP split; never count implicit ORT CPU fallback as an HTP pass

source.state: exact v1.27.1 source with the tracked a08e17 backport applied as an ignored working-tree diff

unpatched_android_build.state: successful reusable arm64 build; it predates the a08e17 backport and must be incrementally relinked before another vocoder phone attempt

patched_host_build.state: successful x86_64 QNN build with the a08e17 backport; reusable for host capability probes

raw_work.state: ignored models, tensors, profiles, logs, and generated runtime staging retained locally

next_steps: On resume, review the consequential choice between an explicit-Gelu graph derivative and an explicitly split CPU/HTP hybrid. The explicit-Gelu derivative is the current recommendation.

If choosing the derivative, create a narrow tool that replaces only the eight proven standard GELU decompositions, records every node and hash, and compares CPU outputs before any HTP output is inspected.
Freeze the numerical and audio thresholds before a formal device vocoder inference gate.
Require a patched host session with CPU fallback disabled before incrementally rebuilding the Android runtime.
Before any new phone command, reacquire artifacts/locks/phone.lock and reconfirm Moritz's availability.
Only after a vocoder output passes delegation and numerical gates should the vector estimator or end-to-end path resume.
